To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the population age structure techniques applied to the Recent populations of the species Pontocythere elongatapermits the definition of three types of population age structures that are closely related with the (paleoenvironmental) conditions in which this species is present.

(i) the application of the population age structure techniques to the Recent populations of the species Pontocythere elonga permits to distinguish three groups of population age structure, closely related to three different types of environment, and (ii) the population age structure of the species Pontocytthere elongata is mainly controlled by its natural growth and the hydrodynamic levels are only a minor factor.

the application of the population age structure techniques to Recent populations of P. elongata collected in coastal sediments of southwestern (SW) Spain allows the definition of three different groups of population age structure, closely related to three different (paleo)-environmental settings: (a) low- to medium energy, (b) high energy and (c) low energy.
